ATS_MODAL.TITLE: Understanding ATS Score
ATS_MODAL.DESC: ATS (Applicant Tracking System) is software used by recruiters to automatically filter resumes before a human reads them.
ATS_MODAL.P1: The system scans your resume for keywords, clean formatting, and relevance to the job description.
ATS_MODAL.TIP_1: Use keywords directly from the job description
ATS_MODAL.TIP_2: Avoid complex layouts (our templates handle this)
ATS_MODAL.TIP_3: Add quantifiable results to your experiences

ROAST.TITLE: Roast my CV (Harsh Mode)
ROAST.DESC: Our AI will act as a strict recruiter and point out the flaws in your resume. Can you handle it?
ROAST.NO_RESUME_DESC: You need to create a resume first to generate a roast.
ROAST.ERROR: The recruiter went for coffee, try again.
ROAST.WORKSPACE_DESC: Select a resume on the left so our AI recruiter can give an honest assessment and point out flaws.
ROAST.SCORE_DESC: Overall score based on resume potential in selection processes.
ROAST.EXAMPLE_STRENGTH_1: Clear focus in professional summary describing achievements and key technologies.
ROAST.EXAMPLE_STRENGTH_2: Experience section with quantifiable impacts and achieved results.
ROAST.EXAMPLE_WEAKNESS_1: Lack of quantifiable metrics in some of the professional experiences.
ROAST.EXAMPLE_WEAKNESS_2: Multi-column formatting may make it difficult for older ATS parsers to read.
ROAST.EXAMPLE_ACTIONABLE_1: Rewrite achievements using the X-Y-Z formula (e.g. Accomplished X, as measured by Y, by doing Z).
ROAST.EXAMPLE_ACTIONABLE_2: Use ATS-friendly single-column resume templates, such as "Minimal" or "Elegance".

CV.MOCK_EXP2_DESC: Development and maintenance of rich interfaces focused on performance and accessibility. Continuous integration with cloud services and comprehensive unit test coverage.
